item.title: Version 1.17.0-beta (99)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.17.0-beta

Build 99

  • Adjust shows every Light, Color Basics, HSL, FX, and Curve control as a stacked slider
  • Color opens Temperature, Tint, Vibrance, and Saturation first, with advanced tools in a list
  • Hold original, Clips, and Reset stay pinned under the panel
  • See trailsrg.com/apps/studio/versions for full notes
